sourceFacts.name: LOW PROFILE
sourceFacts.description: Going prone clears your in-combat state 1.5s faster and reduces your spotted status duration by 33%.

sourceFacts: Fresh Ability_LowProfile and U_Ability_LowProfile are byte-identical to the prior Head4892087 hotfix assets.
Ability imports U and FL; FL imports SimEx; SimEx imports both named SpotDelay and SpotDuration affectors. See the preserved prior receipt and new decoded bodies.
SpotDelay Field_def89065=1.2000000476837158; SpotDuration nested Field_f95f67f4=0.6669999957084656. Field roles remain unnamed.
sourceFacts.comparison: The UI states -33% duration and 1.5s faster combat-state clearing. The affector 0.667 is arithmetically compatible with a 33.3% reduction, but its multiplier role is not proven. No 1.5s source operand is established; do not substitute 1.2.

proposal.value: Going prone clears your in-combat state 1.5s faster and reduces your spotted status duration by 33%.
proposal.activationCertainty: Class/path join and gameplay consumer unresolved. Display as game-stated perk text only.
proposal.validation: Compare the displayed text with StringId 49AF2EAF; prediction is exact text equality. For any future duration model, matched spotted-status tests prone versus standing must show approximately 0.67 duration ratio and combat clearing 1.5s earlier before enabling numeric composition.

sourceFacts: Named GRX_Glacier_Soldier registry leaf Field_42c8b257 values: AdvancedSpotRangeMultiplier = 1.33, AdvancedSpotAngleMultiplier = 1.1, AdvancedSpotDurationIncrease = 3, AdvancedSpotBaseTime 0.25. These are serialized registry operands; effective runtime composition remains unresolved.
sourceFacts.comparison: Named range multiplier and angle multiplier agree with +33% and +10%. Named duration increase 3 agrees with +3s. BaseTime 0.25 accompanies the quicker wording, which states no number. No native consumer or comparison with ordinary spotting time is proven.

proposal.code: ui/app.js optional perk information panel; spotting remains separate from weapon attachment spotting in sim/applyAttachments.js
proposal.activationCertainty: Ability->U and named registry operands are sourced; class/path and native consumer unresolved.
proposal.validation: First compare perk panel numbers to StringId FEDE3CBB. Before a runtime calculator, use a fixed target and weapon with the perk enabled/disabled. Prediction: detection range ratio 1.33, crosshair detection angle ratio 1.10, spotted duration difference 3s. Treat 0.25 as source-only until the timer owner is proven.

sourceFacts: Fresh U_Ability_Killshot exported GUID c9ac1d21-bc55-48ae-a825-90f3b15d6817 matches WM_Killshot selector.
WM_Killshot Field_8d6d2bc1=true at 216. Prior L109 records imports from six site sniper rifles; new hotfix WM has identical raw hash.
New UI text resolves the former missing-text blocker in L116: sniper-rifle headshot kills prevent teammate revive. This does not by itself prove the boolean implementation role.

proposal.data: New data/class-traits.json record Ability_Killshot; sniper category applicability from data/weapons.json remains conditional
proposal.value: Enemy soldiers you kill with headshots from a sniper rifle cannot be revived by their teammates.
proposal.activationCertainty: Ability->U->WM selector identity is exact; class/path activation and boolean consumer unresolved.
proposal.validation: Compare text with StringId 9832F276. Before native applicability display, test enemy teammate revive after sniper headshot versus body-shot kill with perk enabled/disabled. Prediction: only enabled-perk sniper headshot prevents revive. Do not change damage, TTK, recoil or cadence.
